subject: PoC trial plan & deployment mode follow-up (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <s.torres@acme-corp.com>, Priya Menon <priya@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: PoC trial plan & deployment mode follow-up (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for hopping on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the PoC scope and deployment mode decision: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary constraint: data residency & encryption-at-rest requirements (Priya) — leaning toward Dedicated or Private VPC.
- Throughput target: ~200 requests/sec steady, spiky to 800 requests/sec for 2–3 hours/day.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile <= 200ms for the inference endpoint.
- Success criteria for PoC: functional parity with pilot dataset, meeting latency SLO under expected load, and clear perf/cost numbers to inform procurement.

Proposed PoC plan (4 weeks):
1) Week 0: Kickoff + access provisioning (we need sandbox API keys + sample dataset)
2) Week 1–2: Integration + baseline tests (hosted API to validate prompt/outputs)
3) Week 3: Capacity test on Dedicated pool (or Private VPC if you prefer air-gapped) to measure latency/cost
4) Week 4: Results, handoff + next steps (procurement/contract)

Stakeholders to confirm: Sam (CTO) — technical lead; Priya (Head of InfoSec) — compliance sign-off; Mark (SRE) — load test support. Internal Redwood: Marissa (SE) will run the PoC, Jordan (AE) commercial lead, me (Ben) project owner.

Ask from you this week:
- Confirm preferred deployment mode to proceed (Hosted API for fastest path, Dedicated for predictable throughput, Private VPC for strict controls).
- Share a non-sensitive sample dataset or a small synthetic dataset that matches request size distribution.
- Any additional compliance docs you want us to attach (we can share SOC2 evidence).

I attached a 1-page PoC plan to get us started. If you confirm this direction, we’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff with Marissa and Mark.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Subject: Re: PoC trial plan & deployment mode follow-up (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)

Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with our expectations. A few clarifications: 
- Priya confirms data residency: we need logs and storage to remain in our AWS account; Private VPC is preferred from an InfoSec standpoint, but we’re open to evaluating Dedicated if it can satisfy KMS/HSM controls.
- For the PoC, Mark will provide a synthetic workload that simulates our peak; he expects to be available for the load run in the third week.
- Success criteria: 95th <= 200ms as you stated, and cost per 1M tokens under $X (we’ll give you a rough target later).

I’m attaching our SOC2 questionnaire that we started filling — can you have your compliance team review the answers and flag any gaps?

We’re good to start next Monday (4/26) for kickoff. Please send calendar invites.

—Sam
Sam Torres | CTO, Acme Corp

Subject: Re: PoC trial plan & deployment mode follow-up (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)

Hi all —

I reviewed the SOC2 sheet and the PoC plan. A few technical notes and checklist items to make the Dedicated / Private VPC run smooth: 
- For Private VPC: we need VPC peering or PrivateLink access, and a KMS key ARN for envelope encryption.
- For Dedicated: confirm GPU profile (A10G vs A100) and whether you want reserved capacity for the trial window.
- Data: please share a ~10k-record synthetic sample (no PII) and an example of your typical prompt + context size (avg tokens).
- Load test: Mark — can you share the JMeter/load script or specify concurrency distribution?

Proposed technical timeline (internal):
- Day 1: Credentials + VPC checklist completed
- Day 2–5: Integration + smoke tests (Hosted baseline)
- Day 12: Dry run on Dedicated/Private VPC
- Day 14: Full load test + metrics export (latency/cost)

I’ll prepare a short runbook and post it to the shared Drive before kickoff.

-Marissa

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: PoC trial plan & deployment mode follow-up (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)

Ben / Marissa —

All sounds good. Confirming kickoff Monday 4/26 10am PT. Mark will upload the load script by Friday EOD.

Two quick asks before kickoff: 
1) Can you provide a ballpark cost estimate for using Dedicated capacity for the 2-week trial (broken down by expected GPU type and approximate token cost)? We need this for our procurement approval.
2) Priya also asked whether Redwood can provide a short statement on data handling during the PoC (who has access, retention policy).

If you can drop answers in the calendar invite or reply-all, that’ll save time at kickoff.

Thanks — Sam
